scientific_integrity: Analytical proof via critical-point sign count, resultant elimination and regular perturbation. Reproducible symbolic and numerical verifier included; finite checks not presented as infinite proofs.
scientific_limitations: Thermodynamic stationary current of the active-sector Gibbs state only; no finite-size optimization, transient bounds, or open-boundary phase selection. Original current and correlation formulas credited to the motivating preprint. Novelty comparison is qualified and not independently certified.
title: A unique optimal-density reversal and cubic-root transport boundary layer in tandem exclusion
